name: Tengsheng International Co., Limited
description: Tengsheng International exports new and pre-owned vehicles to dealers, fleets and private buyers across the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, Central Asia and Southeast Asia.

hero.title: The right vehicle, from source to shore.
hero.subtitle: Tengsheng International sources, inspects and ships new and pre-owned vehicles to dealers, fleet operators and private buyers across six export regions — with one team handling the paperwork, freight and delivery.
hero.imageAlt: Vehicle loaded and ready for export

featured.title: Featured inventory
featured.intro: A selection of units currently available for export. Specifications, condition reports and additional photographs are shared on request.

strengths.title: One partner, from inquiry to arrival.
strengths.intro: Cross-border vehicle buying fails on details: unclear history, incomplete documents, missed sailing dates. We run each of those details in-house.

items.title: Direct sourcing
items.description: We buy from authorised dealers, leasing fleets and closed auctions — not the open retail market — so specification and history can be verified before you commit.

items.title: Inspected & documented
items.description: Every unit is photographed, condition-reported and checked against its documents. You approve the file before payment and before loading.

items.title: Export-ready paperwork
items.description: Invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, bill of lading, insurance and destination-specific compliance documents prepared as one set.

items.title: Freight & delivery
items.description: FOB, CFR, CIF or DAP terms with ro-ro or container shipping, marine insurance and customs support at destination.

markets.title: Six regions. One export desk.
markets.intro: We focus on left-hand-drive markets with established shipping lanes and clear import rules. If your country is not listed, send us the destination port and we will confirm feasibility.

process.title: A clear path to delivery.
process.intro: Six steps, one point of contact, no surprises between quotation and arrival.

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.description: Share the make, model, year, trim and quantity, plus your destination port and preferred Incoterms.

steps.title: Sourcing & quotation
steps.description: We confirm availability, condition and FOB price, then add a freight estimate for your port.

steps.title: Inspection & approval
steps.description: You receive a full photo set, condition report, mileage and document summary before payment.

steps.title: Contract & payment
steps.description: Proforma invoice and sales contract issued under agreed terms, with a clear deposit and balance schedule.

steps.title: Export & shipping
steps.description: Booking, loading, bill of lading, insurance and certificates handled by our export desk.

steps.title: Arrival & after-sales
steps.description: Destination clearance support, delivery coordination and follow-up on parts or accessories.

cta.title: Tell us what you need. We will source it.
cta.subtitle: Send a model, a destination port and a target budget. You will receive availability, condition and a delivered cost estimate.

about.title: Built for cross-border vehicle trade.
about.lead: Tengsheng International Co., Limited is a vehicle export house supplying new and pre-owned cars, SUVs, pickups and electric vehicles to dealers, fleet operators and private buyers across six export regions.
paragraphs: We work at the point where sourcing, compliance and freight meet. Instead of handing you a list of cars and a shipping contact, we assemble the whole transaction: a verified unit, a condition file, the export documents, a booking on a known sailing and a named person who answers while the vehicle is in transit.

Our supply comes from authorised dealer groups, corporate and leasing fleets, and closed auction channels. That access lets us match exact trims and specifications — including left-hand-drive and GCC-spec vehicles — rather than offering whatever happens to be on a retail lot.

Every market has its own rules on vehicle age, emissions, homologation and documentation. We check those rules before quoting, so a price you receive is a price that can actually be cleared at destination.

principles.title: Transparency first
principles.description: Photographs, condition notes, mileage and document status are shared before you pay. If a unit is not right, we say so.

principles.title: Documents done properly
principles.description: Export files are prepared to the destination country's requirements, not assembled after the vessel sails.

principles.title: One accountable contact
principles.description: The person who quotes your vehicle stays with the order through booking, shipping and arrival.
